name: scenario_0262
description: The user has a collection of images showing excerpts and illustrations from various classic books. They initially want to build a reading list based on recommendations for these books, but eventually decide to purchase the original texts instead.

amazon.products.name: The Tale of Genji
amazon.products.description: A classic work of Japanese literature written by the noblewoman and lady-in-waiting Murasaki Shikibu.

amazon.products.name: Nihon Shoki
amazon.products.description: The Chronicles of Japan, the second-oldest book of classical Japanese history.

amazon.products.name: War and Peace
amazon.products.description: An epic novel by Leo Tolstoy, detailing the history of the French invasion of Russia.

amazon.products.name: The Old Regime and the Revolution
amazon.products.description: A historical and sociological treatise by Alexis de Tocqueville.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: I have some book excerpts and illustrations here. Let's start with the fifth image, which looks like a play script. Can you figure out what play that is, look it up on Amazon, and find its top recommended product? Then create a Todoist project called 'Reading List' and add a task to read that recommended book.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to look at the fifth image, identify the play it comes from, search for it on Amazon to find its top recommended related product, and then create a Todoist project named 'Reading List' with a task to read that recommended book. If the assistant needs help, point it back to the text in the fifth image. Wait for confirmation that the project and task are created before moving on.

ROUND 2
Query: Next, look at the sixth image about population. Figure out what book that is, look it up on Amazon, find its top recommended product, and add that as another task in my 'Reading List' project.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to identify the book shown in the sixth image, look it up on Amazon to find its top recommended product, and add that recommendation as a second task in the 'Reading List' project. Once the assistant confirms the task has been added, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Actually, I changed my mind. I don't want to read the recommended books, I should just read the original texts. Delete the 'Reading List' project. Instead, identify the Japanese painting in the first image, the antique text in the second image, and the book excerpt with underlined text in the third image. Find these three original books on Amazon and add them directly to my cart.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind and want to read the original books instead of the recommendations. Ask it to delete the 'Reading List' project entirely. Then, ask the assistant to identify the books shown in the first, second, and third images, find those three original books on Amazon, and add them directly to your cart. Wait for confirmation that the project is deleted and the three books are in the cart before moving on.

ROUND 4
Query: Finally, identify the book with the highlighted text in the fourth image. Add that one to my Amazon cart as well, and then go ahead and place the order for all the books in the cart.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the book from the fourth image, add it to your Amazon cart, and then place the order for all the books currently in the cart. Once the assistant confirms the order has been successfully placed, you can end the conversation.
